title: Are Emily and Greg Still More Employable than Lakisha and Jamal? Investigating Algorithmic Hiring Bias in the Era of ChatGPT

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution using stereotypically White and African American names on candidate resumes to measure Equal Opportunity Gap (differences in True Positive Rates) in job classification and summarization tasks.
Counterfactual substitution of gender-specific names and pronouns (male vs. female) on candidate resumes to measure Equal Opportunity Gap in LLM hiring recommendations.
Appending a statement explaining an employment gap due to maternity or paternity leave childcare on resumes and comparing the True Positive Rates against resumes without the statement.
Adding a statement to female applicant resumes indicating that the candidate is currently pregnant and evaluating the resulting differences in classification True Positive Rates.
Including a statement of active volunteer support for either the Democratic or Republican Party on resumes and measuring the Equal Opportunity Gap between the two political affiliations.
